1.content:
# VMware reboot watch (VMware extension)
ESXi hosts and VMs from the **VMware extension** (`dt.entity.vmware:host`, `dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`). Uptime comes from `vmware.host.uptime` / `vmware.vm.uptime` (seconds).
**Rebooted within window** = current uptime below **RebootWindow** hours. **Reboots in timeframe** = number of times uptime dropped across the dashboard timeframe, so you see every restart, not only the latest.

2.title: ESXi hosts
2.query:
fetch `dt.entity.vmware:host`
| fieldsAdd esxi_host = entity.name
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.host.uptime`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:host`}
    | fieldsAdd up_d = arrayDelta(up)
    | fieldsAdd up_raw_0 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up)),
                drops_0 = arraySum(iCollectArray(if(up_d[] < 0, 1, else: 0)))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:host`, fields:{up_raw_0, drops_0}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| lookup [
    timeseries up = max(`vmware.host.sys.uptime.latest`), by:{`dt.entity.vmware:host`}
    | fieldsAdd up_d = arrayDelta(up)
    | fieldsAdd up_raw_1 = arrayLast(arrayRemoveNulls(up)),
                drops_1 = arraySum(iCollectArray(if(up_d[] < 0, 1, else: 0)))
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:`dt.entity.vmware:host`, fields:{up_raw_1, drops_1}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd uptime_raw = coalesce(up_raw_0, up_raw_1), reboots_tf = toLong(coalesce(drops_0, drops_1, 0))
| fieldsAdd uptime_hours = uptime_raw * (1.0 / 3600.0)
| fieldsAdd uptime_days = round(uptime_hours / 24, decimals: 1)
| fieldsAdd last_reboot = if(isNull(uptime_hours), null, else: now() - duration(toLong(uptime_hours * 3600), "s"))
| fieldsAdd reboots_tf = coalesce(reboots_tf, 0)
| fieldsAdd rebooted = coalesce(uptime_hours < toDouble($RebootWindow), false)
| lookup [
    fetch `dt.entity.vmware:virtualmachine`
    | fieldsAdd h = runs_on[`dt.entity.vmware:host`], vm_power_state
    | summarize vms = count(), vms_on = countIf(endsWith(lower(toString(vm_power_state)), "on")), by:{h}
  ], sourceField:id, lookupField:h, fields:{vms, vms_on}, executionOrder:leftFirst
| fieldsAdd status = if(isNull(uptime_hours), "No uptime data", else: if(rebooted, "Rebooted within window", else: if(reboots_tf > 0, "Rebooted in timeframe", else: "OK")))
| filter in("*", array($EsxiHost)) or in(esxi_host, array($EsxiHost))
| summarize hosts = count()
